parts:
Thanks, but I need to know the output of either of these two: 

str(Time_shift)
class(Time_shift)

I ask because what is important is not how Excel sees the table, but what kind of object it is in R. 

My guess right now, is it a tibble or data.table? Try running 

Time_shift <- as.data.frame(Time_shift)

and see if it works.

It looks good. To be sure, compare the metadata date/time tag with the date/time field at the bottom of the images. It should differ.

Personally I like to use FastStone image viewer for such quick tasks. digiKam, IrfanView or other viewers also work though.

Best,
Jürgen
